column1: Each CRg has a different strategic focus. Highlights from FY22 include:
> BNN piloted an onboarding program for employees to request a “Friend @
NVIDIA” (F@N) to support new hires. unlike a typical mentor or buddy program,
F@Ns serve as a cultural advisor and help new employees accelerate their
ability to learn, internalize, and thrive at NVIDIA. In response to feedback from
BNN, our health plan partner Cigna has invited Black physicians and mental
health providers used by NVIDIANs to join the network.
> HLN offered a career development program to encourage members to set
career aspirations and work to achieve them.
> NDN formed breakout groups including ADHD NVIDIANs to discuss experiences
and share resources in a safe, nonjudgmental, and neurodiverse-friendly
environment. It also formed the Parents and Caregivers Support group to
provide employees with resources and support.
